_note: Written pages: the writing need (data/world/needs.json) is met by a scribe writing on a surface with ink, so scribes get demand from literate people's use of writing. One recipe for each surface; the household mix chooses among them.

written_page_papyrus.basis: per written page of a letter, account or copied text on papyrus
written_page_papyrus.yield_basis: A page takes one sheet of the writing surface and about a gram or two of ink (1.5 g a page is an estimate). A scribe in a book hand wrote a few pages a day, taken here as three hours a page (an estimate of the work rate, confidence D); document hands were quicker. Services that turn materials into what households use are recipes on the trades that do the work, as the laid walls are.

written_page_parchment.basis: per written page of a letter, account or copied text on parchment
written_page_parchment.yield_basis: A page takes one sheet of the writing surface and about a gram or two of ink (1.5 g a page is an estimate). A scribe in a book hand wrote a few pages a day, taken here as three hours a page (an estimate of the work rate, confidence D); document hands were quicker. Services that turn materials into what households use are recipes on the trades that do the work, as the laid walls are.

written_page_paper.basis: per written page of a letter, account or copied text on paper
written_page_paper.yield_basis: A page takes one sheet of the writing surface and about a gram or two of ink (1.5 g a page is an estimate). A scribe in a book hand wrote a few pages a day, taken here as three hours a page (an estimate of the work rate, confidence D); document hands were quicker. Services that turn materials into what households use are recipes on the trades that do the work, as the laid walls are. A sheet of paper is about five grams.

capital.good: scribe's desk, ruling tools and ink-horn
capital.capital_basis: A scribe copies a page in the three hours the entry states, so one desk turns out about seven hundred pages in a working year; the desk and tools are a plank table, a stool and a few knives, and the item states them so the writing office is not treated as plant-free.
